```{r Wrangle Orthologs}
# Extract P pacificus / C elegans 1-to-1 ortholog pairs
Orthologs <- CelegansPpacificus_dNdS_Table[, c("query_id", "subject_id")]

# Remove version numbers
Orthologs$query_id   <- str_replace(Orthologs$query_id, "\\.[^.]+$", "")
Orthologs$subject_id <- str_replace(Orthologs$subject_id, "\\.[^.]+$", "")

# Rename ortholog columns for clarity
colnames(Orthologs) <- c("Celegans_orthologR", "Ppacificus_orthologR")
```

```{r Setup Features to Test}
# Convert to data.table so `with = FALSE` works
ce_tbl <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants$SaxenaKonrad_2019_MA_Celegans_WS235
pp_tbl <- Annotated_VCFs_PC_Gene_Body_Variants$WellerWang_20142026_MA_Ppacificus_Elpaco
setDT(ce_tbl)
setDT(pp_tbl)

# Identify feature columns:
#   - expression
#   - dNdS
#   - GC_Length
#   - anything beginning with mean_
ce_feature_cols <- unique(c(
  "log2_Expression_Plus_One",
  "GC_Length",
  grep("^mean_", names(ce_tbl), value = TRUE)
))

pp_feature_cols <- unique(c(
  "log2_Expression_Plus_One",
  "GC_Length",
  grep("^mean_", names(pp_tbl), value = TRUE)
))

# Only keep features shared between species
shared_features <- intersect(ce_feature_cols, pp_feature_cols)

# Put expression first, then the rest
shared_features <- c(
  if ("log2_Expression_Plus_One" %in% shared_features) "log2_Expression_Plus_One" else character(0),
  setdiff(shared_features, "log2_Expression_Plus_One")
)

if (length(shared_features) == 0) {
  stop("No shared features found between species.")
}

message("Shared features to analyze:")
print(shared_features)
```

```{r Merge Features Together}
# Merge C. elegans features
ce_keep <- c(
  "GENE_ID",
  "transcript_id",
  "Overall_Expression_Group",
  "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  shared_features[shared_features %in% names(ce_tbl)]
)

ce_join <- ce_tbl[, ce_keep, with = FALSE]

setnames(
  ce_join,
  old = ce_keep,
  new = c(
    "Celegans_GENE_ID",
    "Celegans_orthologR",
    "Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group",
    "Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
    paste0("Celegans_", shared_features[shared_features %in% names(ce_tbl)])
  )
)

Orthologs <- merge(
  Orthologs,
  ce_join,
  by = "Celegans_orthologR",
  all = FALSE
)

# Merge P. pacificus features
pp_keep <- c(
  "GENE_ID",
  "transcript_id",
  "Overall_Expression_Group",
  "UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  shared_features[shared_features %in% names(pp_tbl)]
)

pp_join <- pp_tbl[, pp_keep, with = FALSE]

setnames(
  pp_join,
  old = pp_keep,
  new = c(
    "Ppacificus_GENE_ID",
    "Ppacificus_orthologR",
    "Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group",
    "Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
    paste0("Ppacificus_", shared_features[shared_features %in% names(pp_tbl)])
  )
)

Orthologs <- merge(
  Orthologs,
  pp_join,
  by = "Ppacificus_orthologR",
  all = FALSE
)
```

```{r Codify Overall_Expression_Group into Ordered Numbers}
Orthologs <- Orthologs %>%
  mutate(
    Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 =
      as.integer(Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group) - 1,

    Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 =
      as.integer(Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group) - 1
  )

Orthologs <-
  Orthologs %>%
  mutate(
    CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group =
      paste(Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
            Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
            sep = ">")
  )

Orthologs <-
  Orthologs %>%
  mutate(
    CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change =
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 -
      Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
  )
```

```{r Utility Functions}
setDT(Orthologs)

sample_n_safe <- function(DT, n_target, seed = 1L) {
  if (nrow(DT) == 0 || n_target <= 0) {
    return(DT[0])
  }
  set.seed(seed)
  DT[sample(.N, size = min(.N, n_target))]
}

ordered_int_factor <- function(x) {
  ux <- sort(unique(as.integer(x)))
  factor(as.integer(x), levels = ux, ordered = TRUE)
}

make_count_labels <- function(DT, group_col) {
  x <- DT[[group_col]]
  if (is.null(x)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  if (is.factor(x)) {
    lvls <- levels(x)
    counts <- as.integer(table(factor(x, levels = lvls)))
    names(counts) <- lvls
  } else {
    chars <- as.character(x)
    lvls <- unique(chars)
    counts <- as.integer(table(chars)[lvls])
    names(counts) <- lvls
  }

  setNames(
    paste0(names(counts), "\n(n=", counts, ")"),
    names(counts)
  )
}
```

```{r Analysis Function}
run_feature_analysis <- function(DT_in, feature_name, results_dir) {

  ce_col <- paste0("Celegans_", feature_name)
  pp_col <- paste0("Ppacificus_", feature_name)

  req_cols <- c(
    ce_col,
    pp_col,
    "Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
    "Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP"
  )

  is_expression <- identical(feature_name, "log2_Expression_Plus_One")
  if (is_expression) {
    req_cols <- c(
      req_cols,
      "CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change",
      "Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5",
      "Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5"
    )
  }

  if (!all(req_cols %in% names(DT_in))) {
    message("Skipping ", feature_name, " because one or more columns are missing.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  DT <- copy(DT_in)[complete.cases(DT_in[, ..req_cols])]

  if (nrow(DT) < 10) {
    message("Skipping ", feature_name, " because too few complete observations remain.")
    return(NULL)
  }

  save_plot <- function(p, file, w, h) {
    if (!is.null(p)) ggsave(file, plot = p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 300)
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Percentiles
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  DT[, `:=`(
    feat_rank_ce = rank(get(ce_col), ties.method = "average"),
    feat_rank_pp = rank(get(pp_col), ties.method = "average"),
    mut_rank_ce  = rank(Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average"),
    mut_rank_pp  = rank(Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average")
  )]

  DT[, `:=`(
    feat_pct_ce = feat_rank_ce / .N,
    feat_pct_pp = feat_rank_pp / .N,
    mut_pct_ce  = mut_rank_ce / .N,
    mut_pct_pp  = mut_rank_pp / .N
  )]

  # delta = Ppa relative to Cel
  DT[, `:=`(
    delta_feature = feat_pct_pp - feat_pct_ce,
    delta_mut     = mut_pct_pp - mut_pct_ce
  )]

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scatter plot + Spearman correlation
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cor_test <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(DT$delta_feature, DT$delta_mut, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  )

  p_scatter <-
    ggplot(DT, aes(x = delta_feature, y = delta_mut)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_point(
      size = 2.5,
      colour = "white",
      fill = "black",
      shape = 21,
      stroke = 0.4,
      alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "purple", fill = "orange") +
    scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
    labs(
      x = paste0("Delta ", feature_name, " percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
      y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
      title = paste0(
        "Spearman rho = ",
        round(as.numeric(cor_test$estimate), 3),
        ", p = ",
        signif(cor_test$p.value, 3)
      ),
      subtitle = "Each point represents an ortholog with embryonic expression",
      caption = "Dashed lines = zero; smooth = LOESS"
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # 5 equal-sized bins on delta_feature
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  qs <- unique(as.numeric(quantile(DT$delta_feature, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.2), na.rm = TRUE)))

  bin_summary <- NULL
  p_bins <- NULL

  if (length(qs) >= 2) {
    DT[, feature_bin := cut(delta_feature, breaks = qs, include.lowest = TRUE)]

    bin_summary <- DT[, .(
      mean_delta_mut = mean(delta_mut, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = .N
    ), by = feature_bin]

    bin_summary[, bin_mid := sapply(strsplit(as.character(feature_bin), ","), function(x) {
      vals <- as.numeric(gsub("\\[|\\]|\\(|\\)", "", x))
      mean(vals)
    })]

    bin_summary <- bin_summary[order(bin_mid)]

    bin_labels <- make_count_labels(DT, "feature_bin")

    p_bins <-
      ggplot(bin_summary, aes(x = feature_bin, y = mean_delta_mut, group = 1)) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      theme_minimal() +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = bin_labels) +
      labs(
        x = paste0("Binned delta ", feature_name, " percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        y = paste0("Mean delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        title = paste0("Binned relationship: ", feature_name)
      ) + 
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3))
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Comparing extremes
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  low_group <- DT[delta_feature <= -0.6]
  high_group <- DT[delta_feature >= 0.6]
  middle_all <- DT[abs(delta_feature) < 0.2]

  n_middle <- max(nrow(low_group), nrow(high_group))
  middle_group <- sample_n_safe(middle_all, n_middle, seed = 99)

  wilcox_low_vs_middle <- NULL
  wilcox_high_vs_middle <- NULL
  p_extreme <- NULL
  wilcox_test <- NULL

  if (nrow(low_group) > 0 && nrow(high_group) > 0 && nrow(middle_group) > 0) {
    wilcox_low_vs_middle <- wilcox.test(low_group$delta_mut, middle_group$delta_mut)
    wilcox_high_vs_middle <- wilcox.test(high_group$delta_mut, middle_group$delta_mut)

    extreme_df <- rbindlist(list(
      low_group[, .(group = "Most\nDown", delta_mut = delta_mut)],
      middle_group[, .(group = "Stable\n[<20% Δfeature]", delta_mut = delta_mut)],
      high_group[, .(group = "Most\nUp", delta_mut = delta_mut)]
    ))

    extreme_df[, group := factor(
      group,
      levels = c("Most\nDown", "Stable\n[<20% Δfeature]", "Most\nUp")
    )]

    extreme_labels <- make_count_labels(extreme_df, "group")

    p_extreme <-
      ggplot(extreme_df, aes(x = group, y = delta_mut, fill = group)) +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = extreme_labels) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Most\nDown" = alpha("orange", 0.4),
        "Stable\n[<20% Δfeature]" = alpha("grey40", 0.4),
        "Most\nUp" = alpha("purple", 0.4)
      )) +
      guides(fill = "none") +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        title = paste0(
          "Down vs middle p = ", signif(wilcox_low_vs_middle$p.value, 3),
          "\nUp vs middle p = ", signif(wilcox_high_vs_middle$p.value, 3)
        )
      ) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3),
            plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 2))
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Ordered boxplot for delta-feature bins
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  n_bins <- min(5, length(unique(DT$delta_feature)))

  p_binned <- NULL
  jt <- NULL

  if (n_bins >= 2) {
    DT <- DT %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = as.character(ggplot2::cut_number(delta_feature, n = n_bins))
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = str_replace_all(
          Feature_Change_Group,
          "\\d+\\.?\\d*e[-+]?\\d+",
          ~ format(as.numeric(.x), scientific = FALSE, digits = 6)
        )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Feature_Change_Group = forcats::fct_reorder(
          factor(Feature_Change_Group, ordered = TRUE),
          as.numeric(str_extract(Feature_Change_Group, "(?<=\\[|\\()[^,]+")),
          .fun = min,
          .desc = FALSE
        )
      )

    jt <- clinfun::jonckheere.test(
      DT$delta_mut,
      DT$Feature_Change_Group,
      alternative = "two.sided"
    )

    change_labels <- make_count_labels(DT, "Feature_Change_Group")

    p_binned <-
      ggplot(DT, aes(x = Feature_Change_Group, y = delta_mut, fill = Feature_Change_Group)) +
      geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
      labs(
        title = paste0(
          "Jonckheere = ",
          round(jt$statistic, 3),
          ", p = ",
          round(jt$p.value, 3)
        )
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = change_labels) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(
        c("#3C096C", "#5A189A", "#9D4EDD", "#FFC880", "#FF9100")
      )(length(unique(DT$Feature_Change_Group)))) +
      guides(fill = "none") +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE -3))
  }

    # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Expression-specific analysis
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  cross_group_change_test <- NULL
  lm_model <- NULL
  spearman_change <- NULL
  jt_change <- NULL

  p_cross_group_change <- NULL
  p_up_same_down <- NULL
  p_terminal_5 <- NULL
  p_terminal_0 <- NULL
  p_expression_state_ppa <- NULL
  p_expression_state_cel <- NULL
  p_expression_state_sym <- NULL
  p_continuous_interaction <- NULL
  p_step_interaction <- NULL
  p_validation_abs_delta_expression <- NULL
  p_validation_q5_step_expression <- NULL
  p_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles <- NULL
  p_validation_q5_residuals <- NULL
  p_validation_residuals_all_quantiles <- NULL

  continuous_interaction_p <- NA_real_
  step_interaction_p <- NA_real_
  validation_abs_p <- NA_real_
  validation_q5_step_p <- NA_real_
  validation_step_all_p <- NA_real_
  validation_q5_resid_p <- NA_real_

  cont_summary_df <- NULL
  step_summary_df <- NULL
  step_all_summary_df <- NULL

  wilcox_up_vs_same <- NULL
  wilcox_down_vs_same <- NULL
  wilcox_terminal_5_pp <- NULL
  wilcox_terminal_5_ce <- NULL
  wilcox_terminal_0_pp <- NULL
  wilcox_terminal_0_ce <- NULL

  build_state_plot <- function(DT, focal_col, other_col, plot_title, subtitle_text) {
    state_long <- list()
    state_tests <- list()

    for (q in 0:5) {
      changed <- DT[get(focal_col) == q & get(other_col) != q]
      control <- DT[get(focal_col) == q & get(other_col) == q]

      if (nrow(changed) == 0 || nrow(control) == 0) {
        next
      }

      state_long[[length(state_long) + 1]] <- rbindlist(list(
        changed[, .(
          delta_mut,
          expr_state_q = as.character(q),
          expr_state_type = "Changed"
        )],
        control[, .(
          delta_mut,
          expr_state_q = as.character(q),
          expr_state_type = "Matched control"
        )]
      ), fill = TRUE)

      state_tests[[as.character(q)]] <- wilcox.test(
        changed$delta_mut,
        control$delta_mut
      )
    }

    if (length(state_long) == 0) {
      return(list(plot = NULL, tests = state_tests, data = NULL))
    }

    DT_state_plot <- rbindlist(state_long, fill = TRUE)

    DT_state_plot[, expr_state_q := factor(
      expr_state_q,
      levels = as.character(0:5),
      ordered = TRUE
    )]

    DT_state_plot[, expr_state_type := factor(
      expr_state_type,
      levels = c("Matched control", "Changed")
    )]

    state_counts <- DT_state_plot[, .(
      n_changed = sum(expr_state_type == "Changed"),
      n_control = sum(expr_state_type == "Matched control")
    ), by = expr_state_q][order(expr_state_q)]

    state_labels <- setNames(
      paste0(
        "q = ", state_counts$expr_state_q,
        "\nChanged n = ", state_counts$n_changed,
        " | Control n = ", state_counts$n_control
      ),
      as.character(state_counts$expr_state_q)
    )

    state_strip_labeller <- function(x) {
      unname(state_labels[as.character(x)])
    }

    state_caption <- paste(
      vapply(names(state_tests), function(q) {
        paste0("q=", q, ": p=", signif(state_tests[[q]]$p.value, 3))
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = " | "
    )

    p <- ggplot(DT_state_plot, aes(
      x = expr_state_type,
      y = delta_mut,
      fill = expr_state_type
    )) +
      geom_boxplot(
        width = 0.55,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        alpha = 0.75
      ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ expr_state_q,
        nrow = 1,
        labeller = labeller(expr_state_q = state_strip_labeller)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
        "Matched control" = "Matched control",
        "Changed" = "Changed"
      )) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Matched control" = alpha("grey40", 0.4),
        "Changed" = alpha("purple", 0.45)
      )) +
      guides(fill = "none") +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        title = plot_title,
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        caption = state_caption
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3),
        strip.text = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 6),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5)
      )

    list(plot = p, tests = state_tests, data = DT_state_plot)
  }

  build_symmetric_state_plot <- function(DT, plot_title, subtitle_text) {
    state_long <- list()
    state_tests <- list()

    for (q in 0:5) {
      cel_changed <- DT[
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != q &
          Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == q
      ]
      both <- DT[
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == q &
          Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == q
      ]
      ppa_changed <- DT[
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == q &
          Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != q
      ]

      if (nrow(cel_changed) == 0 && nrow(both) == 0 && nrow(ppa_changed) == 0) {
        next
      }

      if (nrow(cel_changed) > 0) {
        state_long[[length(state_long) + 1]] <- cel_changed[, .(
          delta_mut,
          expr_state_q = as.character(q),
          expr_state_type = "Cel Changed"
        )]
      }

      if (nrow(both) > 0) {
        state_long[[length(state_long) + 1]] <- both[, .(
          delta_mut,
          expr_state_q = as.character(q),
          expr_state_type = "Both"
        )]
      }

      if (nrow(ppa_changed) > 0) {
        state_long[[length(state_long) + 1]] <- ppa_changed[, .(
          delta_mut,
          expr_state_q = as.character(q),
          expr_state_type = "Ppa Changed"
        )]
      }

      if (nrow(cel_changed) > 0 && nrow(both) > 0) {
        state_tests[[paste0("q=", q, "_cel")]] <- wilcox.test(
          cel_changed$delta_mut,
          both$delta_mut
        )
      }

      if (nrow(ppa_changed) > 0 && nrow(both) > 0) {
        state_tests[[paste0("q=", q, "_ppa")]] <- wilcox.test(
          ppa_changed$delta_mut,
          both$delta_mut
        )
      }
    }

    if (length(state_long) == 0) {
      return(list(plot = NULL, tests = state_tests, data = NULL))
    }

    DT_state_plot <- rbindlist(state_long, fill = TRUE)

    DT_state_plot[, expr_state_q := factor(
      expr_state_q,
      levels = as.character(0:5),
      ordered = TRUE
    )]

    DT_state_plot[, expr_state_type := factor(
      expr_state_type,
      levels = c("Cel Changed", "Both", "Ppa Changed")
    )]

    state_counts <- DT_state_plot[, .(
      n_cel_changed = sum(expr_state_type == "Cel Changed"),
      n_both = sum(expr_state_type == "Both"),
      n_ppa_changed = sum(expr_state_type == "Ppa Changed")
    ), by = expr_state_q][order(expr_state_q)]

    state_labels <- setNames(
      paste0(
        "q = ", state_counts$expr_state_q,
        "\nCel Changed n = ", state_counts$n_cel_changed,
        " | Both n = ", state_counts$n_both,
        " | Ppa Changed n = ", state_counts$n_ppa_changed
      ),
      as.character(state_counts$expr_state_q)
    )

    state_strip_labeller <- function(x) {
      unname(state_labels[as.character(x)])
    }

    state_caption <- paste(
      vapply(names(state_tests), function(test_name) {
        parts <- strsplit(test_name, "_", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
        q_part <- sub("^q=", "", parts[1])
        which_part <- if (parts[2] == "cel") {
          "Cel Changed vs Both"
        } else {
          "Ppa Changed vs Both"
        }
        paste0(
          "q=", q_part, " ", which_part, ": p=",
          signif(state_tests[[test_name]]$p.value, 3)
        )
      }, character(1)),
      collapse = " | "
    )

    p <- ggplot(DT_state_plot, aes(
      x = expr_state_type,
      y = delta_mut,
      fill = expr_state_type
    )) +
      geom_boxplot(
        width = 0.55,
        outlier.shape = NA,
        alpha = 0.75
      ) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ expr_state_q,
        nrow = 1,
        labeller = labeller(expr_state_q = state_strip_labeller)
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
        "Cel Changed" = "Cel Changed",
        "Both" = "Both",
        "Ppa Changed" = "Ppa Changed"
      )) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Cel Changed" = alpha("orange", 0.4),
        "Both" = alpha("grey40", 0.4),
        "Ppa Changed" = alpha("purple", 0.45)
      )) +
      guides(fill = "none") +
      labs(
        x = "",
        y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
        title = plot_title,
        subtitle = subtitle_text,
        caption = state_caption
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3),
        strip.text = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 6),
        plot.caption = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 6.5)
      )

    list(plot = p, tests = state_tests, data = DT_state_plot)
  }

  if (is_expression) {

    # (1) Up / Same / Down expression-group comparison
    DT_updown <- DT[
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
    ]

    DT_same_all <- DT[
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
    ]

    n_up <- DT_updown[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change > 0, .N]
    n_down <- DT_updown[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change < 0, .N]
    n_control <- max(n_up, n_down)

    DT_same <- sample_n_safe(DT_same_all, n_control, seed = 101)

    if (nrow(DT_same) > 0 && (n_up > 0 || n_down > 0)) {
      DT_plot1 <- rbindlist(list(
        DT_updown[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change > 0,
                  .(delta_mut, expr_group = "+ Ppa < Cel")],
        DT_same[, .(delta_mut, expr_group = "Stable")],
        DT_updown[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change < 0,
                  .(delta_mut, expr_group = "- Ppa < Cel")]
      ), fill = TRUE)

      DT_plot1[, expr_group := factor(
        expr_group,
        levels = c("- Ppa < Cel", "Stable", "+ Ppa < Cel")
      )]

      if (DT_plot1[expr_group == "+ Ppa < Cel", .N] > 0 &&
          DT_plot1[expr_group == "Stable", .N] > 0) {
        wilcox_up_vs_same <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ expr_group,
          data = DT_plot1[expr_group %in% c("+ Ppa < Cel", "Stable")]
        )
      }

      if (DT_plot1[expr_group == "- Ppa < Cel", .N] > 0 &&
          DT_plot1[expr_group == "Stable", .N] > 0) {
        wilcox_down_vs_same <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ expr_group,
          data = DT_plot1[expr_group %in% c("- Ppa < Cel", "Stable")]
        )
      }

      updown_labels <- make_count_labels(DT_plot1, "expr_group")

      p_up_same_down <-
        ggplot(DT_plot1, aes(x = expr_group, y = delta_mut, fill = expr_group)) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = updown_labels) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(
          "- Ppa < Cel" = alpha("orange", 0.4),
          "Stable" = alpha("grey40", 0.4),
          "+ Ppa < Cel" = alpha("purple", 0.4)
        )) +
        guides(fill = "none") +
        labs(
          x = "Expression quantile change",
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0(
            "Up vs Stable, p = ",
            ifelse(is.null(wilcox_up_vs_same), NA, signif(wilcox_up_vs_same$p.value, 3)),
            "\nDown vs Stable, p = ",
            ifelse(is.null(wilcox_down_vs_same), NA, signif(wilcox_down_vs_same$p.value, 3))
          )
        ) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3),
          plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 2)
        )
    }

    # (2) Ordered boxplot for expression quantile change
    DT_plot2 <- DT

    if (nrow(DT_plot2) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_plot2$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change) > 1) {
      DT_plot2[, expr_change_grp := ordered_int_factor(CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change)]

      jt_change <- clinfun::jonckheere.test(
        DT_plot2$delta_mut,
        DT_plot2$expr_change_grp,
        alternative = "two.sided"
      )

      cross_group_change_test <- kruskal.test(
        delta_mut ~ expr_change_grp,
        data = DT_plot2
      )

      change_labels <- make_count_labels(DT_plot2, "expr_change_grp")

      p_cross_group_change <-
        ggplot(DT_plot2, aes(
          x = expr_change_grp,
          y = delta_mut,
          fill = expr_change_grp
        )) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = change_labels) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = colorRampPalette(
          c("#006837", "orange", "purple")
        )(nlevels(DT_plot2$expr_change_grp))) +
        guides(fill = "none") +
        labs(
          x = "Expression group change (Ppa - Cel)",
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0(
            "Jonckheere p = ", signif(jt_change$p.value, 3),
            "\nKruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(cross_group_change_test$p.value, 3)
          )
        )
    }

    # (3) Group 0 asymmetry vs same-in-both control
    DT0_pp <- DT[
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0 &
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 0
    ]
    DT0_ce <- DT[
      Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0 &
        Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 0
    ]
    DT0_control_all <- DT[
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0 &
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 0
    ]

    n0_control <- max(nrow(DT0_pp), nrow(DT0_ce))
    DT0_control <- sample_n_safe(DT0_control_all, n0_control, seed = 202)

    if (nrow(DT0_control) > 0 && (nrow(DT0_pp) > 0 || nrow(DT0_ce) > 0)) {
      DT0_plot <- rbindlist(list(
        DT0_pp[, .(delta_mut, expr_group = "Ppa = 0, Cel != 0")],
        DT0_control[, .(delta_mut, expr_group = "Both 0")],
        DT0_ce[, .(delta_mut, expr_group = "Cel = 0, Ppa != 0")]
      ), fill = TRUE)

      DT0_plot[, expr_group := factor(
        expr_group,
        levels = c("Ppa = 0, Cel != 0", "Both 0", "Cel = 0, Ppa != 0")
      )]

      if (nrow(DT0_pp) > 0 && nrow(DT0_control) > 0) {
        wilcox_terminal_0_pp <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ expr_group,
          data = DT0_plot[expr_group %in% c("Ppa = 0, Cel != 0", "Both 0")]
        )
      }

      if (nrow(DT0_ce) > 0 && nrow(DT0_control) > 0) {
        wilcox_terminal_0_ce <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ expr_group,
          data = DT0_plot[expr_group %in% c("Cel = 0, Ppa != 0", "Both 0")]
        )
      }

      zero_labels <- make_count_labels(DT0_plot, "expr_group")

      p_terminal_0 <-
        ggplot(DT0_plot, aes(x = expr_group, y = delta_mut, fill = expr_group)) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = zero_labels) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(
          "Ppa = 0, Cel != 0" = alpha("purple", 0.4),
          "Both 0" = alpha("grey40", 0.4),
          "Cel = 0, Ppa != 0" = alpha("orange", 0.4)
        )) +
        guides(fill = "none") +
        labs(
          x = "",
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0(
            "Ppa=0 vs control p = ",
            ifelse(is.null(wilcox_terminal_0_pp), NA, signif(wilcox_terminal_0_pp$p.value, 3)),
            "\nCel=0 vs control p = ",
            ifelse(is.null(wilcox_terminal_0_ce), NA, signif(wilcox_terminal_0_ce$p.value, 3))
          )
        ) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 2)
        )
    }

    # (4) Group 5 asymmetry vs same-in-both control
    DT5_pp <- DT[
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5 &
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 5
    ]
    DT5_ce <- DT[
      Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5 &
        Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 != 5
    ]
    DT5_control_all <- DT[
      Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5 &
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5
    ]

    n5_control <- max(nrow(DT5_pp), nrow(DT5_ce))
    DT5_control <- sample_n_safe(DT5_control_all, n5_control, seed = 203)

    if (nrow(DT5_control) > 0 && (nrow(DT5_pp) > 0 || nrow(DT5_ce) > 0)) {
      DT5_plot <- rbindlist(list(
        DT5_pp[, .(delta_mut, expr_group = "Ppa = 5, Cel != 5")],
        DT5_control[, .(delta_mut, expr_group = "Both 5")],
        DT5_ce[, .(delta_mut, expr_group = "Cel = 5, Ppa != 5")]
      ), fill = TRUE)

      DT5_plot[, expr_group := factor(
        expr_group,
        levels = c("Ppa = 5, Cel != 5", "Both 5", "Cel = 5, Ppa != 5")
      )]

      if (nrow(DT5_pp) > 0 && nrow(DT5_control) > 0) {
        wilcox_terminal_5_pp <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ expr_group,
          data = DT5_plot[expr_group %in% c("Ppa = 5, Cel != 5", "Both 5")]
        )
      }

      if (nrow(DT5_ce) > 0 && nrow(DT5_control) > 0) {
        wilcox_terminal_5_ce <- wilcox.test(
          delta_mut ~ expr_group,
          data = DT5_plot[expr_group %in% c("Cel = 5, Ppa != 5", "Both 5")]
        )
      }

      five_labels <- make_count_labels(DT5_plot, "expr_group")

      p_terminal_5 <-
        ggplot(DT5_plot, aes(x = expr_group, y = delta_mut, fill = expr_group)) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = five_labels) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c(
          "Ppa = 5, Cel != 5" = alpha("purple", 0.4),
          "Both 5" = alpha("grey40", 0.4),
          "Cel = 5, Ppa != 5" = alpha("orange", 0.4)
        )) +
        guides(fill = "none") +
        labs(
          x = "",
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          title = paste0(
            "Ppa=5 vs control p = ",
            ifelse(is.null(wilcox_terminal_5_pp), NA, signif(wilcox_terminal_5_pp$p.value, 3)),
            "\nCel=5 vs control p = ",
            ifelse(is.null(wilcox_terminal_5_ce), NA, signif(wilcox_terminal_5_ce$p.value, 3))
          )
        ) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 2)
        )
    }

    # (5) Matched-control expression-state plots in both directions
    ppa_state <- build_state_plot(
      DT = DT,
      focal_col = "Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5",
      other_col = "Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5",
      plot_title = "Matched-control expression-state plot (Ppa-directed)",
      subtitle_text = "Changed = Ppa = q, Cel != q; control = Ppa = q, Cel = q"
    )

    cel_state <- build_state_plot(
      DT = DT,
      focal_col = "Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5",
      other_col = "Ppacificus_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5",
      plot_title = "Matched-control expression-state plot (Cel-directed)",
      subtitle_text = "Changed = Cel = q, Ppa != q; control = Cel = q, Ppa = q"
    )

    p_expression_state_ppa <- ppa_state$plot
    p_expression_state_cel <- cel_state$plot
    sym_state <- build_symmetric_state_plot(
      DT = DT,
      plot_title = "Symmetric expression-state plot",
      subtitle_text = "Cel Changed = Cel != q & Ppa = q; Both = Cel = q & Ppa = q; Ppa Changed = Cel = q & Ppa != q"
    )
    p_expression_state_sym <- sym_state$plot

    # (6) Continuous interaction model by starting Cel quantile
    safe_spearman <- function(x, y) {
      if (length(x) < 3 || length(unique(x)) < 2 || length(unique(y)) < 2) {
        return(list(rho = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
      }
      ct <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
      )
      list(
        rho = as.numeric(ct$estimate),
        p = ct$p.value
      )
    }

    cont_palette <- setNames(
      colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(6),
      as.character(0:5)
    )

    DT_cont <- DT[, .(
      delta_feature,
      delta_mut,
      Cel_start_q = Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
    )]
    DT_cont <- DT_cont[complete.cases(DT_cont)]
    DT_cont[, Cel_start_q := factor(
      Cel_start_q,
      levels = 0:5,
      ordered = TRUE
    )]

    if (nrow(DT_cont) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_cont$Cel_start_q) > 1) {
      cont_summary_df <- DT_cont[, {
        ss <- safe_spearman(delta_feature, delta_mut)
        .(
          n = .N,
          spearman_rho = ss$rho,
          spearman_p = ss$p
        )
      }, by = Cel_start_q][order(Cel_start_q)]

      cont_labels <- setNames(
        paste0(
          "q = ", cont_summary_df$Cel_start_q,
          "
ρ = ", ifelse(is.na(cont_summary_df$spearman_rho), "NA", signif(cont_summary_df$spearman_rho, 3)),
          "
p = ", ifelse(is.na(cont_summary_df$spearman_p), "NA", signif(cont_summary_df$spearman_p, 3)),
          "
n = ", cont_summary_df$n
        ),
        as.character(cont_summary_df$Cel_start_q)
      )

      cont_labeller <- function(x) {
        unname(cont_labels[as.character(x)])
      }

      lm_cont_base <- lm(
        delta_mut ~ delta_feature + Cel_start_q,
        data = DT_cont
      )
      lm_cont_interaction <- lm(
        delta_mut ~ delta_feature * Cel_start_q,
        data = DT_cont
      )

      continuous_interaction_p <- anova(lm_cont_base, lm_cont_interaction)$`Pr(>F)`[2]

      p_continuous_interaction <-
        ggplot(DT_cont, aes(
          x = delta_feature,
          y = delta_mut,
          colour = Cel_start_q,
          fill = Cel_start_q
        )) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(
          size = 1.4,
          alpha = 0.25
        ) +
        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = TRUE
        ) +
        facet_wrap(
          ~ Cel_start_q,
          nrow = 2,
          labeller = labeller(Cel_start_q = cont_labeller),
          scales = "free_x"
        ) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = cont_palette) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cont_palette) +
        scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 8) +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        guides(colour = "none", fill = "none") +
        labs(
          title = "Interaction model: delta mutation vs delta expression by starting Cel quantile",
          subtitle = paste0(
            "lm(delta_mut ~ delta_feature * Cel_start_q); interaction p = ",
            signif(continuous_interaction_p, 3)
          ),
          x = paste0("Delta expression percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          caption = "Facet labels show Spearman rho, p, and n within each starting quantile."
        ) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3),
          strip.text = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5)
        )
    }



    # (7) Faceted interaction model using quantile-change steps
    DT_step <- DT[, .(
      delta_mut,
      Step_change = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
      Cel_start_q = Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5
    )]
    DT_step <- DT_step[complete.cases(DT_step)]
    DT_step[, Cel_start_q := factor(
      Cel_start_q,
      levels = 0:5,
      ordered = TRUE
    )]

    if (nrow(DT_step) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_step$Cel_start_q) > 1) {
      step_summary_df <- DT_step[, {
        ss <- safe_spearman(Step_change, delta_mut)
        .(
          n = .N,
          spearman_rho = ss$rho,
          spearman_p = ss$p
        )
      }, by = Cel_start_q][order(Cel_start_q)]

      step_labels <- setNames(
        paste0(
          "q = ", step_summary_df$Cel_start_q,
          "
ρ = ", ifelse(is.na(step_summary_df$spearman_rho), "NA", signif(step_summary_df$spearman_rho, 3)),
          "
p = ", ifelse(is.na(step_summary_df$spearman_p), "NA", signif(step_summary_df$spearman_p, 3)),
          "
n = ", step_summary_df$n
        ),
        as.character(step_summary_df$Cel_start_q)
      )

      step_labeller <- function(x) {
        unname(step_labels[as.character(x)])
      }

      lm_step_base <- lm(
        delta_mut ~ Step_change + Cel_start_q,
        data = DT_step
      )
      lm_step_interaction <- lm(
        delta_mut ~ Step_change * Cel_start_q,
        data = DT_step
      )

      step_interaction_p <- anova(lm_step_base, lm_step_interaction)$`Pr(>F)`[2]

      p_step_interaction <-
        ggplot(DT_step, aes(
          x = Step_change,
          y = delta_mut,
          colour = Cel_start_q,
          fill = Cel_start_q
        )) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        geom_point(
          size = 1.4,
          alpha = 0.25
        ) +
        geom_smooth(
          method = "lm",
          formula = y ~ x,
          se = TRUE
        ) +
        facet_wrap(
          ~ Cel_start_q,
          nrow = 2,
          labeller = labeller(Cel_start_q = step_labeller),
          scales = "free_x"
        ) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = cont_palette) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cont_palette) +
        scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 8) +
        scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10) +
        guides(colour = "none", fill = "none") +
        labs(
          title = "Interaction model: delta mutation vs quantile-change steps by starting Cel quantile",
          subtitle = paste0(
            "lm(delta_mut ~ Step_change * Cel_start_q); interaction p = ",
            signif(step_interaction_p, 3)
          ),
          x = paste0("Expression group change (Ppa - Cel; steps; ", delta_phrase, ")"),
          y = paste0("Delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")"),
          caption = "Facet labels show Spearman rho, p, and n within each starting quantile."
        ) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3),
          strip.text = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5)
        )
    }

    # (8) Validation plots for q5 step interpretation and continuous change
    DT_validation_abs <- DT[, .(
      abs_delta_feature = abs(delta_feature),
      start_q = factor(
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
        levels = 0:5,
        ordered = TRUE
      )
    )]
    DT_validation_abs <- DT_validation_abs[complete.cases(DT_validation_abs)]

    if (nrow(DT_validation_abs) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_validation_abs$start_q) > 1) {
      validation_abs_p <- kruskal.test(
        abs_delta_feature ~ start_q,
        data = DT_validation_abs
      )$p.value

      abs_labels <- make_count_labels(DT_validation_abs, "start_q")

      p_validation_abs_delta_expression <-
        ggplot(DT_validation_abs, aes(x = start_q, y = abs_delta_feature, fill = start_q)) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = abs_labels) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = cont_palette) +
        guides(fill = "none") +
        labs(
          title = "Validation: absolute delta expression by starting Cel quantile",
          subtitle = paste0(
            "Kruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(validation_abs_p, 3),
            "; q5-to-q? transitions may simply reflect larger expression shifts"
          ),
          x = "Starting Cel quantile",
          y = paste0("Absolute delta expression percentile (", delta_phrase, ")")
        ) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3)
        )
    }

    DT_q5_step <- DT[
      Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5 == 5,
      .(
        delta_feature,
        delta_mut,
        Step_change = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change
      )
    ]
    DT_q5_step <- DT_q5_step[complete.cases(DT_q5_step)]

    if (nrow(DT_q5_step) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_q5_step$Step_change) > 1) {
      q5_step_levels <- paste0("5→", 5:0)
      DT_q5_step[, step_label := factor(
        paste0("5→", 5 + Step_change),
        levels = q5_step_levels
      )]

      q5_step_palette <- setNames(
        colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(length(q5_step_levels)),
        q5_step_levels
      )

      validation_q5_step_p <- kruskal.test(
        delta_feature ~ step_label,
        data = DT_q5_step
      )$p.value

      q5_step_labels <- make_count_labels(DT_q5_step, "step_label")

      p_validation_q5_step_expression <-
        ggplot(DT_q5_step, aes(x = step_label, y = delta_feature, fill = step_label)) +
        geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
        geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
        scale_x_discrete(labels = q5_step_labels) +
        scale_fill_manual(values = q5_step_palette) +
        guides(fill = "none") +
        labs(
          title = "Validation: continuous delta expression within q5 step classes",
          subtitle = paste0(
            "Kruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(validation_q5_step_p, 3),
            "; 5→4 etc. should correspond to distinct continuous shifts if steps are meaningful"
          ),
          x = "q5 transition class",
          y = paste0("Delta expression percentile (", delta_phrase, ")")
        ) +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3)
        )
    }

    DT_validation_step_all <- DT[, .(
      delta_feature,
      delta_mut,
      start_q = factor(
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
        levels = 0:5,
        ordered = TRUE
      ),
      Step_change = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change
    )]
    DT_validation_step_all <- DT_validation_step_all[complete.cases(DT_validation_step_all)]

    if (nrow(DT_validation_step_all) > 0) {
      DT_validation_step_all[, end_q := as.integer(as.character(start_q)) + Step_change]
      DT_validation_step_all[, transition_label := factor(
        paste0(as.integer(as.character(start_q)), "→", end_q),
        levels = unlist(lapply(0:5, function(q) paste0(q, "→", 0:5)))
      )]
      DT_validation_step_all[, step_factor := factor(
        Step_change,
        levels = sort(unique(DT_validation_step_all$Step_change))
      )]

      if (uniqueN(DT_validation_step_all$start_q) > 1) {
        step_all_summary_df <- DT_validation_step_all[, .(
          n = .N,
          kw_p = if (uniqueN(transition_label) > 1) {
            kruskal.test(delta_feature ~ transition_label)$p.value
          } else {
            NA_real_
          }
        ), by = start_q][order(start_q)]

        step_all_labels <- setNames(
          paste0(
            "q = ", step_all_summary_df$start_q,
            "\nKruskal-Wallis p = ", ifelse(is.na(step_all_summary_df$kw_p), "NA", signif(step_all_summary_df$kw_p, 3)),
            "\nn = ", step_all_summary_df$n
          ),
          as.character(step_all_summary_df$start_q)
        )

        step_all_labeller <- function(x) {
          unname(step_all_labels[as.character(x)])
        }

        step_all_palette <- setNames(
          colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(nlevels(DT_validation_step_all$step_factor)),
          levels(DT_validation_step_all$step_factor)
        )

        transition_labels_all <- make_count_labels(DT_validation_step_all, "transition_label")

        p_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles <-
          ggplot(
            DT_validation_step_all,
            aes(
              x = transition_label,
              y = delta_feature,
              fill = step_factor
            )
          ) +
          geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
          scale_x_discrete(labels = transition_labels_all) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = step_all_palette) +
          guides(fill = "none") +
          facet_wrap(
            ~ start_q,
            ncol = 3,
            labeller = labeller(start_q = step_all_labeller),
            scales = "free_x"
          ) +
          labs(
            title = "Validation: continuous delta expression within step classes across all starting quantiles",
            subtitle = "Faceted across starting quantiles; step classes should correspond to distinct continuous shifts if step labels are meaningful",
            x = "Transition class",
            y = paste0("Delta expression percentile (", delta_phrase, ")")
          ) +
          theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3),
            strip.text = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5)
          )
      }
    }

    DT_validation_resid <- DT[, .(
      delta_feature,
      delta_mut,
      Cel_start_q = factor(
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
        levels = 0:5,
        ordered = TRUE
      ),
      Step_change = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change
    )]
    DT_validation_resid <- DT_validation_resid[complete.cases(DT_validation_resid)]

    if (nrow(DT_validation_resid) > 0) {
      lm_validation_global <- lm(
        delta_mut ~ delta_feature,
        data = DT_validation_resid
      )
      DT_validation_resid[, resid_mut := resid(lm_validation_global)]

      DT_q5_resid <- DT_validation_resid[Cel_start_q == 5]

      if (nrow(DT_q5_resid) > 0 && uniqueN(DT_q5_resid$Step_change) > 1) {
        q5_step_levels <- paste0("5→", 5:0)
        DT_q5_resid[, step_label := factor(
          paste0("5→", 5 + Step_change),
          levels = q5_step_levels
        )]

        validation_q5_resid_p <- kruskal.test(
          resid_mut ~ step_label,
          data = DT_q5_resid
        )$p.value

        q5_resid_labels <- make_count_labels(DT_q5_resid, "step_label")
        q5_resid_palette <- setNames(
          colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(length(q5_step_levels)),
          q5_step_levels
        )

        p_validation_q5_residuals <-
          ggplot(DT_q5_resid, aes(x = step_label, y = resid_mut, fill = step_label)) +
          geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
          scale_x_discrete(labels = q5_resid_labels) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = q5_resid_palette) +
          guides(fill = "none") +
          labs(
            title = "Validation: q5 residual mutation change after controlling for delta expression",
            subtitle = paste0(
              "Kruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(validation_q5_resid_p, 3),
              "; if q5 remains special, residuals should differ by q5 step class"
            ),
            x = "q5 transition class",
            y = paste0("Residual delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")")
          ) +
          theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3)
          )
      }
    }
    DT_validation_resid_all <- DT[, .(
      delta_feature,
      delta_mut,
      start_q = factor(
        Celegans_Overall_Expression_Group_0to5,
        levels = 0:5,
        ordered = TRUE
      ),
      Step_change = CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change
    )]
    DT_validation_resid_all <- DT_validation_resid_all[complete.cases(DT_validation_resid_all)]

    if (nrow(DT_validation_resid_all) > 0) {
      lm_validation_global_all <- lm(
        delta_mut ~ delta_feature,
        data = DT_validation_resid_all
      )
      DT_validation_resid_all[, resid_mut := resid(lm_validation_global_all)]

      DT_validation_resid_all[, end_q := as.integer(as.character(start_q)) + Step_change]
      DT_validation_resid_all[, transition_label := factor(
        paste0(as.integer(as.character(start_q)), "→", end_q),
        levels = unlist(lapply(0:5, function(q) paste0(q, "→", 0:5)))
      )]
      DT_validation_resid_all[, step_factor := factor(
        Step_change,
        levels = sort(unique(DT_validation_resid_all$Step_change))
      )]

      if (uniqueN(DT_validation_resid_all$start_q) > 1) {
        resid_all_summary_df <- DT_validation_resid_all[, .(
          n = .N,
          kw_p = if (uniqueN(transition_label) > 1) {
            kruskal.test(resid_mut ~ transition_label)$p.value
          } else {
            NA_real_
          }
        ), by = start_q][order(start_q)]

        resid_all_labels <- setNames(
          paste0(
            "q = ", resid_all_summary_df$start_q,
            "\nKruskal-Wallis p = ", ifelse(is.na(resid_all_summary_df$kw_p), "NA", signif(resid_all_summary_df$kw_p, 3)),
            "\nn = ", resid_all_summary_df$n
          ),
          as.character(resid_all_summary_df$start_q)
        )

        resid_all_labeller <- function(x) {
          unname(resid_all_labels[as.character(x)])
        }

        resid_all_palette <- setNames(
          colorRampPalette(c("#006837", "orange", "purple"))(nlevels(DT_validation_resid_all$step_factor)),
          levels(DT_validation_resid_all$step_factor)
        )

        transition_labels <- make_count_labels(DT_validation_resid_all, "transition_label")

        p_validation_residuals_all_quantiles <-
          ggplot(
            DT_validation_resid_all,
            aes(
              x = transition_label,
              y = resid_mut,
              fill = step_factor
            )
          ) +
          geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.75) +
          geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
          scale_x_discrete(labels = transition_labels) +
          scale_fill_manual(values = resid_all_palette) +
          guides(fill = "none") +
          facet_wrap(
            ~ start_q,
            ncol = 3,
            labeller = labeller(start_q = resid_all_labeller),
            scales = "free_x"
          ) +
          labs(
            title = "Validation: residual mutation change after controlling for delta expression",
            subtitle = "Faceted across starting quantiles; residuals should differ if a starting quantile has effects beyond delta expression",
            x = "Transition class",
            y = paste0("Residual delta mutation percentile (", delta_phrase, ")")
          ) +
          theme(
            axis.text.x = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 3),
            strip.text = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5),
            plot.caption = element_text(size = BASE_SIZE - 5)
          )
      }
    }



    # Trend / regression plot for numeric expression-group change
    DT_trend <- DT[CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change != 0]

    if (nrow(DT_trend) > 0 &&
        uniqueN(DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change) > 1) {

      lm_model <- lm(
        delta_mut ~ CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
        data = DT_trend
      )

      spearman_change <- suppressWarnings(
        cor.test(
          DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change,
          DT_trend$delta_mut,
          method = "spearman",
          exact = FALSE
        )
      )

      jt_change <- clinfun::jonckheere.test(
        DT_trend$delta_mut,
        ordered_int_factor(DT_trend$CrossSpecies_Overall_Expression_Group_Change),
        alternative = "two.sided"
      )
    }
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save outputs
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  safe_name <- str_replace_all(feature_name, "[^A-Za-z0-9_]+", "_")
  feature_dir <- file.path(results_dir, safe_name)
  dir.create(feature_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  prefix <- file.path(feature_dir, safe_name)

  save_plot(p_scatter, paste0(prefix, "_scatter.png"), 5, 4.5)

  if (!is.null(p_bins)) {
    save_plot(p_bins, paste0(prefix, "_binned_mean.png"), 5, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_extreme)) {
    save_plot(p_extreme, paste0(prefix, "_extremes.png"), 2, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_binned)) {
    save_plot(p_binned, paste0(prefix, "_ordered_bins.png"), 4.0, 5.5)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_up_same_down)) {
    save_plot(p_up_same_down, paste0(prefix, "_expression_up_same_down_boxplot.png"), 2, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_cross_group_change)) {
    save_plot(p_cross_group_change, paste0(prefix, "_expression_group_change_jonckheere_boxplot.png"), 5.0, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_terminal_0)) {
    save_plot(p_terminal_0, paste0(prefix, "_expression_group_0_boxplot.png"), 2.0, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_terminal_5)) {
    save_plot(p_terminal_5, paste0(prefix, "_expression_group_5_boxplot.png"), 2.0, 5.0)
  }

  if (!is.null(p_expression_state_ppa)) {
    save_plot(
      p_expression_state_ppa,
      paste0(prefix, "_expression_state_faceted_boxplot_PpaDirected.png"),
      8.5,
      5.0
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_expression_state_cel)) {
    save_plot(
      p_expression_state_cel,
      paste0(prefix, "_expression_state_faceted_boxplot_CelDirected.png"),
      8.5,
      5.0
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_expression_state_sym)) {
    save_plot(
      p_expression_state_sym,
      paste0(prefix, "_expression_state_faceted_boxplot_symmetric.png"),
      8.5,
      5.0
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_validation_abs_delta_expression)) {
    save_plot(
      p_validation_abs_delta_expression,
      paste0(prefix, "_validation_abs_delta_expression.png"),
      5,
      4.5
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_validation_q5_step_expression)) {
    save_plot(
      p_validation_q5_step_expression,
      paste0(prefix, "_validation_q5_step_expression.png"),
      5,
      4.5
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles)) {
    save_plot(
      p_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles,
      paste0(prefix, "_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles.png"),
      11,
      8
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_validation_q5_residuals)) {
    save_plot(
      p_validation_q5_residuals,
      paste0(prefix, "_validation_q5_residuals.png"),
      5,
      4.5
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_validation_residuals_all_quantiles)) {
    save_plot(
      p_validation_residuals_all_quantiles,
      paste0(prefix, "_validation_residuals_all_quantiles.png"),
      11,
      8
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_continuous_interaction)) {
    save_plot(
      p_continuous_interaction,
      paste0(prefix, "_continuous_interaction_faceted_plot.png"),
      8.5,
      6.5
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(p_step_interaction)) {
    save_plot(
      p_step_interaction,
      paste0(prefix, "_step_interaction_faceted_plot.png"),
      8.5,
      6.5
    )
  }

  fwrite(
    as.data.table(DT),
    file.path(feature_dir, paste0(safe_name, "_full_data.csv"))
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Return
  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  list(
    feature = feature_name,
    n = nrow(DT),
    spearman_rho = as.numeric(cor_test$estimate),
    spearman_p = cor_test$p.value,
    wilcox_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_test)) wilcox_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    jonckheere_statistic = if (!is.null(jt)) as.numeric(jt$statistic) else NA_real_,
    jonckheere_p = if (!is.null(jt)) jt$p.value else NA_real_,

    extreme_down_vs_middle_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_low_vs_middle)) wilcox_low_vs_middle$p.value else NA_real_,
    extreme_up_vs_middle_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_high_vs_middle)) wilcox_high_vs_middle$p.value else NA_real_,

    up_vs_same_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_up_vs_same)) wilcox_up_vs_same$p.value else NA_real_,
    down_vs_same_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_down_vs_same)) wilcox_down_vs_same$p.value else NA_real_,
    cross_group_change_p = if (!is.null(cross_group_change_test)) cross_group_change_test$p.value else NA_real_,
    lm_slope = if (!is.null(lm_model)) coef(lm_model)[2] else NA_real_,
    lm_p = if (!is.null(lm_model)) summary(lm_model)$coefficients[2, 4] else NA_real_,
    spearman_change_p = if (!is.null(spearman_change)) spearman_change$p.value else NA_real_,
    jt_change_p = if (!is.null(jt_change)) jt_change$p.value else NA_real_,
    continuous_interaction_p = continuous_interaction_p,
    step_interaction_p = step_interaction_p,
    validation_abs_p = validation_abs_p,
    validation_q5_step_p = validation_q5_step_p,
    validation_step_all_p = validation_step_all_p,
    validation_q5_resid_p = validation_q5_resid_p,

    wilcox_terminal_5_pp_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_terminal_5_pp)) wilcox_terminal_5_pp$p.value else NA_real_,
    wilcox_terminal_5_ce_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_terminal_5_ce)) wilcox_terminal_5_ce$p.value else NA_real_,
    wilcox_terminal_0_pp_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_terminal_0_pp)) wilcox_terminal_0_pp$p.value else NA_real_,
    wilcox_terminal_0_ce_p = if (!is.null(wilcox_terminal_0_ce)) wilcox_terminal_0_ce$p.value else NA_real_,

    data = DT,
    cor_test = cor_test,
    p_scatter = p_scatter,
    bin_summary = bin_summary,
    p_bins = p_bins,
    wilcox_test = wilcox_test,
    p_extreme = p_extreme,
    p_binned = p_binned,
    p_up_same_down = p_up_same_down,
    p_cross_group_change = p_cross_group_change,
    p_expression_state_ppa = p_expression_state_ppa,
    p_expression_state_cel = p_expression_state_cel,
    p_expression_state_sym = p_expression_state_sym,
    p_validation_abs_delta_expression = p_validation_abs_delta_expression,
    p_validation_q5_step_expression = p_validation_q5_step_expression,
    p_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles = p_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles,
    p_validation_q5_residuals = p_validation_q5_residuals,
    p_validation_residuals_all_quantiles = p_validation_residuals_all_quantiles,
    p_continuous_interaction = p_continuous_interaction,
    p_step_interaction = p_step_interaction,
    p_terminal_5 = p_terminal_5,
    p_terminal_0 = p_terminal_0
  )
}
```

```{r Running the Function}
      step_interaction_p = res$step_interaction_p,

    if (!is.null(res$p_up_same_down)) print(res$p_up_same_down)
    if (!is.null(res$p_cross_group_change)) print(res$p_cross_group_change)
    if (!is.null(res$p_expression_state_ppa)) print(res$p_expression_state_ppa)
    if (!is.null(res$p_expression_state_cel)) print(res$p_expression_state_cel)
    if (!is.null(res$p_expression_state_sym)) print(res$p_expression_state_sym)
    if (!is.null(res$p_validation_abs_delta_expression)) print(res$p_validation_abs_delta_expression)
    if (!is.null(res$p_validation_q5_step_expression)) print(res$p_validation_q5_step_expression)
    if (!is.null(res$p_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles)) print(res$p_validation_step_expression_all_quantiles)
    if (!is.null(res$p_validation_q5_residuals)) print(res$p_validation_q5_residuals)
    if (!is.null(res$p_validation_residuals_all_quantiles)) print(res$p_validation_residuals_all_quantiles)
    if (!is.null(res$p_continuous_interaction)) print(res$p_continuous_interaction)
    if (!is.null(res$p_step_interaction)) print(res$p_step_interaction)
    if (!is.null(res$p_terminal_0)) print(res$p_terminal_0)
    if (!is.null(res$p_terminal_5)) print(res$p_terminal_5)
  }
}

if (length(summary_table) > 0) {
  summary_dt <- rbindlist(summary_table, fill = TRUE)
  fwrite(summary_dt, file.path(results_dir, "feature_association_summary.csv"))
  saveRDS(feature_results, file.path(results_dir, "feature_association_results.rds"))
  summary_dt
} else {
  summary_dt <- data.table()
  summary_dt
}
```

```{r LASSO}
# Build a single delta dataset from the merged ortholog table
DT_lasso <- copy(Orthologs)

# Remove dNdS from the LASSO predictors
lasso_features <- shared_features

# Keep only columns needed to compute all deltas plus mutation rate
lasso_keep_cols <- c(
  "Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  "Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP",
  paste0("Celegans_", lasso_features),
  paste0("Ppacificus_", lasso_features)
)

DT_lasso <- DT_lasso[complete.cases(DT_lasso[, ..lasso_keep_cols])]

# Compute percentile-based deltas for every LASSO feature
for (feat in lasso_features) {
  ce_col <- paste0("Celegans_", feat)
  pp_col <- paste0("Ppacificus_", feat)

  DT_lasso[, paste0("rank_ce_", feat) := rank(get(ce_col), ties.method = "average")]
  DT_lasso[, paste0("rank_pp_", feat) := rank(get(pp_col), ties.method = "average")]

  DT_lasso[, paste0("pct_ce_", feat) := get(paste0("rank_ce_", feat)) / .N]
  DT_lasso[, paste0("pct_pp_", feat) := get(paste0("rank_pp_", feat)) / .N]

  # delta = Ppa relative to Cel
  DT_lasso[, paste0("delta_", feat) := get(paste0("pct_pp_", feat)) - get(paste0("pct_ce_", feat))]
}

DT_lasso[, delta_mut :=
  rank(Ppacificus_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average") / .N -
  rank(Celegans_UniqueVariantsPlusOnePerBP, ties.method = "average") / .N
]

# Predictors for LASSO
delta_cols <- grep("^delta_", names(DT_lasso), value = TRUE)
predictors <- setdiff(delta_cols, "delta_mut")

# Drop zero-variance predictors
pred_sds <- sapply(DT_lasso[, ..predictors], sd, na.rm = TRUE)
predictors <- names(pred_sds)[is.finite(pred_sds) & pred_sds > 0]

if (length(predictors) < 2) {
  stop("Too few usable delta predictors remain for LASSO.")
}

# Train/test split
set.seed(69)
index <- createDataPartition(DT_lasso$delta_mut, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
train_df <- DT_lasso[index]
test_df  <- DT_lasso[-index]

# Prepare matrices
x_train_raw <- as.data.frame(train_df[, ..predictors])
x_test_raw  <- as.data.frame(test_df[, ..predictors])

X_train <- scale(x_train_raw)
X_test <- scale(
  x_test_raw,
  center = attr(X_train, "scaled:center"),
  scale  = attr(X_train, "scaled:scale")
)

y_train <- train_df$delta_mut
y_test  <- test_df$delta_mut

# Cross-validated LASSO
cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
  x = as.matrix(X_train),
  y = y_train,
  alpha = 1,
  nfolds = 10
)

# Evaluate
pred_test <- as.numeric(predict(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min", newx = as.matrix(X_test)))
test_R2 <- cor(pred_test, y_test)^2
test_RMSE <- sqrt(mean((y_test - pred_test)^2))

# LASSO coefficients
coef_mat <- as.matrix(coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min"))
coef_df <- data.frame(
  variable = rownames(coef_mat),
  coefficient = as.numeric(coef_mat[, 1]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(variable != "(Intercept)")

# ----------------------------
# Compute Spearman coefficients and p-values on deltas
# ----------------------------
spearman_plot_df <- lapply(predictors, function(v) {
  ct <- suppressWarnings(
    cor.test(
      DT_lasso[[v]],
      DT_lasso$delta_mut,
      method = "spearman",
      exact = FALSE
    )
  )

  data.frame(
    variable = gsub("^delta_", "", v),
    coefficient = as.numeric(ct$estimate),
    p_value = pmax(ct$p.value, 1e-300),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(
    logp = pmin(-log10(p_value), 20),
    test = "Spearman",
    sign = ifelse(coefficient >= 0, "pos", "neg")
  )

# ----------------------------
# Clean LASSO coefficients
# ----------------------------
lasso_plot_df <- coef_df %>%
  mutate(
    variable = gsub("^delta_", "", variable),
    test = "LASSO"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    spearman_plot_df %>% select(variable, spearman_coef = coefficient, p_value, logp),
    by = "variable"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(logp)) %>%
  mutate(
    logp = pmin(logp, 20),
    sign = ifelse(spearman_coef >= 0, "pos", "neg")
  )

# Keep only shared variables
common_vars <- intersect(lasso_plot_df$variable, spearman_plot_df$variable)
lasso_plot_df <- lasso_plot_df %>% filter(variable %in% common_vars)
spearman_plot_df <- spearman_plot_df %>% filter(variable %in% common_vars)

# ----------------------------
# Normalise coefficients (within each test)
# ----------------------------
lasso_plot_df <- lasso_plot_df %>%
  group_by(test) %>%
  mutate(coef_norm = coefficient / max(abs(coefficient), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

spearman_plot_df <- spearman_plot_df %>%
  group_by(test) %>%
  mutate(coef_norm = coefficient / max(abs(coefficient), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# ----------------------------
# Order EVERYTHING by Spearman coefficient
# ----------------------------
var_levels <- spearman_plot_df %>%
  arrange(coefficient) %>%
  pull(variable)

lasso_plot_df$variable <- factor(lasso_plot_df$variable, levels = var_levels)
spearman_plot_df$variable <- factor(spearman_plot_df$variable, levels = var_levels)

# ----------------------------
# Combine
# ----------------------------
combined_df <- bind_rows(
  lasso_plot_df %>% select(variable, coefficient, coef_norm, p_value, logp, sign, test),
  spearman_plot_df %>% select(variable, coefficient, coef_norm, p_value, logp, sign, test)
)

# Ensure facet order: Spearman on the left, LASSO on the right
combined_df$test <- factor(combined_df$test, levels = c("Spearman", "LASSO"))

# ----------------------------
# Plot
# ----------------------------
lasso_plot <-
  ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = variable, y = coef_norm)) +

  geom_col(
    data = subset(combined_df, sign == "neg"),
    aes(fill = logp),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "orange",
    high = "#ff1f00",
    name = expression(-log[10](p)),
    guide = guide_colourbar(
    barheight = unit(2, "cm"),
    barwidth = unit(0.3, "cm")
  )) +

  ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +

  geom_col(
    data = subset(combined_df, sign == "pos"),
    aes(fill = logp),
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#a6d96a",
    high = "#006837",
    name = expression(-log[10](p)),
    guide = guide_colourbar(
    barheight = unit(2, "cm"),
    barwidth = unit(0.3, "cm"))) +

  coord_flip() +
  facet_grid(~test, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(
    title = "Drivers of Delta Mutation Percentile",
    subtitle = paste0("Test R² = ", round(test_R2, 4), " | RMSE = ", round(test_RMSE, 4), " | Delta features are oriented ", delta_phrase),
    x = "Feature (ordered by Spearman)",
    y = "Normalised coefficient (within test)"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(n.breaks = 10)

lasso_plot

# ----------------------------
# Save
# ----------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "delta_LASSO_Spearman_ordered_by_spearman.png"),
  plot = lasso_plot,
  width = 7,
  height = 3,
  dpi = 2000,
  bg = "transparent"
)
```
